tagline: Secure multi-chain wallet management and operations
description: Anvil's Wallet Management provides secure wallet creation, synchronization, and operations across multiple blockchain networks. Manage your wallets, export keys securely, and track swap transactions all in one place.

core_capabilities.name: Wallet Synchronization
core_capabilities.description: Sync wallets from frontend and manage multiple wallets per user

core_capabilities.name: Secure Wallet Export
core_capabilities.description: Export wallet private keys with HPKE encryption for secure key management

core_capabilities.name: Swap Transaction Tracking
core_capabilities.description: Save and track completed swap transactions for portfolio history

how_it_works:
Wallet Management works by:
1. Users connect wallets through frontend integration
2. Wallets are synchronized to backend via POST /api/v1/wallet/sync
3. Wallet addresses and metadata are stored securely
4. Users can export private keys with HPKE encryption when needed
5. Swap transactions are automatically tracked and saved
6. Wallet data integrates with portfolio and transaction systems

for_users.quick_start:
To get started with Wallet Management:
1. Connect your wallet through the Anvil frontend
2. Wallets are automatically synchronized to your account
3. View your wallets: GET /api/v1/wallet/me
4. Export private keys securely when needed: POST /api/v1/wallet/export
5. Swap transactions are automatically tracked
use_cases: Manage multiple wallets across different chains
Securely export private keys when needed
Organize wallets by purpose or chain

common_questions.question: How do I connect my wallet?
common_questions.answer: Connect your wallet through the Anvil frontend. Wallets are automatically synchronized to your account via POST /api/v1/wallet/sync. You can then view all your wallets using GET /api/v1/wallet/me.

common_questions.question: Is it safe to export my private key?
common_questions.answer: Yes! Private keys are exported using HPKE (Hybrid Public Key Encryption), which provides industry-leading security. The key is encrypted before transmission and can only be decrypted with your encryption key.

common_questions.question: Can I have multiple wallets?
common_questions.answer: Yes! Anvil supports multiple wallets per user. Each wallet can be configured with a default chain and metadata. Use GET /api/v1/wallet/me to see all your wallets.

common_questions.question: How are swap transactions tracked?
common_questions.answer: When you complete a swap through Anvil, the transaction is automatically saved via POST /api/v1/wallet/swaps/complete. This creates a record with transaction hash, tokens swapped, amounts, and timestamp for portfolio history.

common_questions.question: What chains are supported?
common_questions.answer: Wallet Management supports Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, and Bitcoin (address format detection). EVM wallets are used for portfolio tracking, while Bitcoin addresses are detected and filtered appropriately.

security.key_storage: Encrypted keys never stored in plaintext
